items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I remember going up and meeting Wellman Braud

ctx.x: Well, mostly I was watching. It's the same thing as one nighters today. If somebody is busy, they don't have much time for you.

Well, who had time for you? The reason I'm asking this is because I can remember when I was your age, and there is only a few years difference between you and I, and I'm on the senior side, but I remember going up and meeting Wellman Braud and just hoping that he would drop his rosin so I could hand it to him, behind his bow -- and I did get to meet him backstage. And I had some conversation. I want to hear about some of your conversations -- some of these wonderful people that you're telling me about, I want to…

Well, I was a little shy about approaching people. My eyes would open wide, but rather than -- which I should have done, but I didn't have that kind of a background. It happened a year or so later after I got out of my home town. After I got out of my home town, I went out in '33 -- Dan Murphy's Musical Skippers came to my home town and they needed a drummer -- this is all behind my back now -- a local bass player was collecting tacks.
